<div class="card-body">
'''R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">R4-E1（アーフォー・イーワン）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ビークル（乗用クリーチャーは除く）にのみ配備し、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度に＋1。常にビークルに乗っていることができ、その時は人員なしで移動できる。宇宙船用の操縦ドロイドとしての能力はない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-25o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビークルのコンピュータ操作用ドロイドの一体。製造はインダストリアル・オートマトン社。このユニット、R4-E1はボシェックに付き添っている。無鉄砲で独立心旺盛。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone).

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on a vehicle (except a creature vehicle). Power, maneuver, and landspeed +1. May remain aboard and move the vehicle with no other personnel. Has no astromech capability.

'''Lore:''' A vehicle computer droid by Industrial Automaton. This unit, R4-E1, accompanies BoShek. Reckless and fiercely independent.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
